status: initial development protocol; not final-test frozen
scope: train and validation only; bounding-box regions, not sign segmentation
occlusion_anchor: stable random corner per image and box, shared by O1/O2/O3 for nested masks
overlap_policy: union masks; process overlapping pixels once; preserve every original annotation
pixel_rounding: floor/ceil clipped half-open boxes; ceil rectangle dimensions, actual coverage recorded
